description:
Before you apply, please get familiar with Luxoft:


  • Luxoft locations:
  • Logeek Magazine:
  • Luxoft Alumni Club:



Mandatory Skills Description:


  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills


Project Description:


  • One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.
  • You will be a member of a cross functional team.
  • Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.
  • Project is based on SCRUM methodology.
  • This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies


Responsibilities:


  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams

title: LAB Quality System Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for LAB Quality System Engineer .


In this role you will:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of solutions and contribute to overall project success. The role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a strong foundation in the life sciences and manufacturing engineering domain, with a focus on MES systems.

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Actively participate and contribute to team discussions, planning, and technical evaluations.
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Design, develop, and implement software solutions aligned with business requirements and compliance needs.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, and project stakeholders to deliver robust application solutions.
  • Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Support the troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues in the MES environment.


We have some requirements:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).
  • Hands-on experience in application architecture, design patterns, and development practices.
  • Fluent English

title: VMWare VCF Consultant (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a VMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formation to work remotely for a client in the US.


The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. This role focuses on building stable, scalable environments using vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and SRM, while enabling hybrid‑cloud capabilities.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains.
  • Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, and SRM.
  • Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization.
  • Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments.
  • Produce documentation and operational handoff materials.
  • Support DR architecture and testing.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation
  • Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage.
  • Hands‑on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, SRM.
  • Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.g. Dell VxRail).
  • Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred

  • VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX).
  • Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam.
  • Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

Você é apaixonado pelo mundo dos pagamentos e quer liderar a expansão comercial da próxima geração de infraestrutura fintech no maior mercado da América Latina?


Na Akua estamos construindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do futuro para a região: cloud-native, API-first e com inteligência artificial integrada. Nossa missão é ajudar bancos, fintechs, credenciadoras e grandes comerciantes a conectar múltiplos rails de pagamento, automatizar conciliações e simplificar sua infraestrutura financeira.


Estamos buscando a pessoa que vai liderar nosso crescimento comercial no Brasil : alguém que entenda profundamente o ecossistema de adquirência e meios de pagamento locais , fale a língua dos bancos, fintechs e credenciadoras, e tenha energia e visão para construir do zero.


O que buscamos?


Um/a Business Development Manager com sólida experiência no ecossistema de pagamentos brasileiro — especialmente em adquirência e meios de pagamento — e uma rede de contatos estabelecida em bancos, fintechs e credenciadoras/subadquirentes.


Você será o primeiro ponto de contato comercial da Akua no Brasil, responsável por gerar e fechar oportunidades estratégicas, com projeção clara de montar e liderar o time comercial do país à medida que escalamos.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Engenheiro de Vendas
description:
Olá, nós somos a CDHORIZON BRAZIL.

A Horizon Construction Development Limited (“CDHORIZON”) é uma empresa líder em aluguel de equipamentos na China, comprometida em fornecer soluções completas em um único ponto de “producto + serviço” para seus clientes nos setores de construção e industrial.


Fundada em 2011 na China, ocupando o 11 lugar no ranking IRN 100, a CDHORIZON possue mais de 560 redes na China e no exterior, atendendo acumulativamente mais de 360.000 clientes no mercado chinês e internacional.


Em 2023, a CDHORIZON foi listada na Bolsa Principal de Hong Kong (SEHK), com o código de ação 09930.HK. A empresa realiza investimentos contínuos em Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) e inovação. Nos últimos anos, a empresa expandiu-se stivamente para mercados internacionis e atualmente opera os negócios no Vietnã,Hong Kong, Malásia, Tailândia, Indonésia, Arábia Saudita, Turquia e Emirados Árabes Unidos, e agora Brazil!


Engenheiro de Vendas de Equipamentos construção civil e industriais


(Mandarim é necessario)

(Local de Trabalho: São Paulo, Brasil)

(Viagens de negócios iniciais a Xangai por 3 a 6 meses, seguidas de residência permanente trabalho no Brasil.)


Responsabilidades:

1. Responsável pelas vendas de máquinas e equipamentos industriais no mercado brasileiro.

2. Desenvolver e manter uma carteira de clientes no Brasil.

3. Conduzir negociações comerciais, assinatura de contratos e acompanhamento de recebimento de pagamentos.

4. Coletar e analisar informações sobre a concorrência em mercados internacionais.


Requisitos:

1. Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas internacionais de equipamentos industriais.

2. Proficiência em conhecimento de máquinas e equipamentos, com capacidade para realizar demonstrações técnicas de forma independente.

3. Excelentes habilidades de negociação comercial, fluência em chinês e português, e capacidade de utilizá-los como idiomas de trabalho.

title: Sales Manager for Children’s Online Courses (Remote)
description:
Join Kodland’s Team!


Kodland is an international online school where kids and teens master digital skills and create their future in the tech world.

If you’re a driven sales professional who wants to be part of something meaningful — this is your opportunity!

✨We’re looking for an Online Sales Manager for Children’s Courses!✨


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead engaging online demo lessons (50 minutes) for children aged 5–17 and their parents — all warm leads, no cold calls .
  • Present Kodland’s learning format, help families choose the right course, and convert interest into enrollments.
  • Build trust, handle objections, and motivate students to start their learning journey with us.


What We Expect:

  • Strong communication and persuasive skills, ideally with experience in sales or educational consulting.
  • Advanced level of English — confident speaking with both parents and students.
  • Ability to work via Zoom or Google Meet in the afternoon/evening hours (starting from 14:00 US time), including one weekend day of your choice. Approximately 25 hours per week.
  • Reliable technical setup: PC (8 GB RAM or more), webcam, headset, and stable internet connection.


What We Offer:

Global team: collaborate with supportive colleagues from around the world.

High earning potential: typical monthly income is around 1200$, with top performers reaching 2200$.

Flexible remote work: manage your own schedule and work from anywhere.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
iSoftStone, Inc. is seeking an IT Support Engineer to join our Team

in Sao Paulo, Brazil!

*THIS IS A PART-TIME POSITION FOR AN INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR*


Responsibilites:


Infrastructure Design Implementation:

• Design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable IT infrastructure.

• Deploy and manage server environments (physical, virtual, cloud-based).

• Evaluate, configure, and install hardware components (e.g., routers, firewalls, storage devices).


Network Management:

• Monitor, maintain, and optimize network performance (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewall, routers, switches).

• Ensure network security protocols are implemented, including firewalls and intrusion detection systems (IDS).

• Troubleshoot network issues and provide solutions promptly.


Server and Cloud Management:

• Manage and maintain servers (Windows, Linux) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

• Perform patch management, updates, and upgrades to systems and applications.

• Automate tasks through scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python) and orchestration tools.


Backup, Recovery, and Disaster Recovery:

• Develop and maintain backup strategies, including regular testing of recovery processes.

• Implement disaster recovery plans (DRP) and business continuity solutions.


Monitoring and Performance Management:

• Set up system and network monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix) to ensure uptime and performance.

• Conduct regular performance analysis and capacity planning.

• Generate reports on system performance, availability, and utilization.


Security and Compliance:

• Implement IT security measures in accordance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST).

• Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and security audits.

• Ensure compliance with data privacy and protection regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).


IT Operations and Support:

• Provide Level 2/3 & On-site support to resolve user issues and escalate complex problems.

• Document systems, procedures, and best practices for operation and troubleshooting.


Collaboration and Vendor Management:

• Work with cross-functional teams to align IT infrastructure with business goals.

• Collaborate with vendors for procurement and support of IT hardware/software.

• Manage relationships with external service providers and cloud vendors.

• Fluency in Mandarin is preferred.


iSoftStone is a global IT service and consulting company that creates value and drives success through technology solutions, service excellence, and digital innovation. We specialize in web and application development, software testing and support, data and content management, digital experience, accessibility, and data for machine learning and AI. title: Executivo de vendas
description:
A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais. Estamos à procura de um Executivo de Vendas para se juntar à nossa equipe e atuar com os produtos de software da Freshworks.


Responsabilidades:

  • Análise de Necessidades: Compreender as necessidades dos clientes em potencial e identificar como as soluções da Freshworks podem atendê-las.
  • Demonstrações de Produtos: Realizar demonstrações técnicas dos produtos Freshworks para clientes potenciais, destacando suas funcionalidades e benefícios.
  • Suporte ao Ciclo de Vendas: Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de vendas para elaborar propostas técnicas.
  • Configuração e Customização: Auxiliar na configuração e personalização das soluções Freshworks para atender às especificidades dos clientes.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Coletar feedback dos clientes e colaborar com as equipes de produto e desenvolvimento para melhorar continuamente as soluções oferecidas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação: Graduação ou Cursando ( 02 ano em diante ) Administração, Finanças e/ou Areas de Tecnologia.
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente com produtos de software.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Familiaridade com os produtos da Freshworks ou outras plataformas de CRM, suporte ao cliente ou ITSM .
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com a capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos de maneira clara e concisa.
  • Orientação ao Cliente: Foco em atender às necessidades dos clientes e fornecer soluções que agreguem valor aos seus negócios.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes equipes e stakeholders.
  • Inglês: Alguma proficiência em inglês é um diferencial. Benefícios: Pacote de benefícios atrativo, incluindo plano de saúde, vale-refeição, vale transporte e participação nos resultados (PPR), Salário Fixo + Comissão.


Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, possui habilidades técnicas e de comunicação e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que está na vanguarda das soluções de software. Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes com as soluções da Bravo!

title: Analista de Dados

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).


About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.



Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.


What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU


Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments


Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth

TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

title: Tax Analyst
description:
Tax Analyst - Ferragamo


About the Company

Ferragamo is a globally recognized Italian luxury fashion house, specialized in high-end footwear, leather goods, ready-to-wear, silk products, eyewear, watches, and accessories. With a strong heritage of craftsmanship and innovation, Ferragamo operates worldwide in the luxury retail industry.


We are currently seeking a Tax Analyst to join our team in a multinational retail environment.


Position Summary

The Tax Analyst will focus on Linx system operations, tax routines, and support for tax processes, including participation in tax reform implementation projects.


Key Responsibilities


Tax Operations in the Linx System

  • Creation of purchase and import orders;
  • Recording and posting of tax invoices;
  • Billing and issuance of tax invoices;
  • Issuance of electronic correction letters (CC-e);
  • Maintenance and update of product master data (tax classification, NCM, CST, CFOP, tax rates, etc.);
  • Maintenance and parameterization of tax rules in the system;
  • Maintenance of tax tables and rates.


Tax Routines and Compliance

  • Analysis and resolution of tax and operational discrepancies;
  • Support for internal and external audits;
  • Monitoring Brazilian tax legislation and assessing operational impacts;
  • Calculation of taxes on imported services;
  • Issuance of tax payment forms (MIT – DCTFWeb) and GNREs;
  • Support in direct and indirect tax calculations and ancillary obligations.


Projects & Process Improvement

  • Technical tax support in projects, including tax reform implementation;
  • Review and improvement of tax and operational processes;
  • Interface with accounting, logistics, operations, and IT teams;
  • Participation in system updates and automation initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English and/or Spanish is desirable for collaboration within a multinational environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields;
  • Mandatory knowledge of Linx ERP system;
  • Previous experience in tax routines within retail companies;
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation, especially indirect taxes;
  • Experience in tax or system implementation projects.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:

About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

A Granistone é referência global na produção de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, combinando tradição, inovação e sustentabilidade. Fundada em 1989, somos uma empresa cearense com presença internacional, que atua em toda a cadeia produtiva — da extração à entrega de materiais exclusivos para projetos de alto padrão. Nosso compromisso vai além da excelência: valorizamos a ética, a responsabilidade ambiental e relações duradouras. Aqui, você fará parte de um time apaixonado pelo que faz, com espaço para crescer, inovar e transformar.

Temos valores cristãos, bons costumes e ética.

Agimos com verdade, honestidade e integridade;

Respeitamos o próximo;

Liberalismo econômico;

Atitude, Garra e Pro atividade;

Trabalhamos com união e confiabilidade

Ensino superior concluído em Engenharia de Minas , Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, ou áreas afins;

Pós graduação nas áreas correlatas;

Experiência na função;

Vivência no segmento de Mineração é um diferencial;

Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos;

Conhecimentos intermediários em Excel;

Conhecimento Avançado em Planejamento e Controle de Produção – PCP;

Conhecimento Intermediário em Gestão da Qualidade;

Conhecimento em Gestão Orçamentária;



Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e coordenar as operações de extração de rochas, assegurando a eficiência e segurança dos processos;
  • Desenvolver planos de lavra e estudar a viabilidade econômica de jazidas de rochas ornamentais;
  • Analisar e interpretar dados geológicos para otimizar a extração de materiais;
  • Garantir que as operações de mineração estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações ambientais e de segurança;
  • Coordenar o processo de perfuração, desmonte e transporte de rochas;
  • Coordenar as atividades de escavação e transporte, garantindo a correta disposição dos materiais extraídos;
  • Avaliar as condições dos terrenos e determinar os melhores métodos de extração, levando em consideração fatores ambientais e técnicos;
  • Gerir os recursos necessários para as operações de mineração, incluindo mão de obra, equipamentos e insumos;
  • Colaborar com o planejamento estratégico da empresa, fornecendo dados sobre a capacidade de produção e custos;
  • Implementar e monitorar técnicas de otimização de produção e redução de custos operacionais;
  • Coordenar a manutenção de equipamentos de mineração e garantir sua operacionalidade contínua;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre as condições da mina e os resultados das operações;
  • Acompanhar o controle de qualidade do material extraído, verificando sua conformidade com as especificações;
  • Desenvolver e implementar práticas sustentáveis e de recuperação ambiental nas áreas de mineração;
  • Coordenar a aplicação de tecnologias inovadoras para aumentar a eficiência e segurança das operações;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho das operações de lavra, propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Coordenar os riscos operacionais relacionados à segurança do trabalho e ao meio ambiente;
  • Realizar auditorias periódicas nas operações de mineração para garantir o cumprimento de normas e procedimentos;
  • Manter atualizados todos os cadastros no ERP relativos ao processo produtivo: estruturas de produtos, roteiros de operações, mão-de-obra para produção dos itens e demais cadastros necessários, garantindo a confiabilidade de tais dados no sistema;
  • Compor juntamente com o superior imediato os planos de produção de acordo com demandas de equipamentos e os níveis de estoque, de forma a garantir disponibilidade do estoque mínimo estratégico de equipamentos e suas partes;
  • Coordenar os processos de produção através do monitoramento de indicadores, realização de reuniões periódicas com a equipe, informando as metas da empresa à equipe de trabalho, definindo ações, e /ou estratégias para o planejamento, execução e controle, visando otimização da produção e redução de falhas;
  • Acompanhar saldo de material no estoque e solicitações e pedidos de compras, obtendo prazos de entrega e disponibilidade de materiais, evitando descontinuidade na produção;
  • Monitorar planilhas de acompanhamento de produção, elaborar cronograma das atividades e organizar a produção de acordo com a demanda, mantendo o almoxarifado abastecido;
  • Promover melhorias no processo de produção, trabalhando em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos técnicos e de qualidade, segurança, higiene, saúde e preservação ambiental;
  • Inspecionar as condições de máquinas e equipamentos e requisitar a manutenção quando necessário, elaborando plano de manutenção preventiva/corretiva;
  • Elaborar e coordenar o desmembramento do Plano de Produção da Mina, acompanhando sua execução e realizando as adequações necessárias;
  • Controlar custos de produção, identificando e implantando oportunidades de redução;
  • Executar demais atividades correlatas ao cargo, segundo necessidades da área e direcionamento do gestor.

title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong experience recruiting for the US market within LATAM nearshore models.

We are seeking a talent advisor who understands technology trends, competitive compensation landscapes, and how to build high-impact pipelines in complex, fast-moving environments.

Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist

Location: Brasil (Remote Position)

Start Date: ASAP

Length: Permanent (Full-Time)

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Spanish verbal and written communication skills


Description:

Recruit solid information technology and engineering professionals in different countries, such as Brazil, Colombia, United States, Mexico, Canada, etc.

  • Execute sourcing and engagement strategies designed to identify qualified active and passive candidates through various sourcing channels.
  • Develop and maintain a network of contacts to identify qualified, diverse, and talented candidates; maintain current market knowledge and external trends.
  • Build and maintain meaningful and trusted relationships that result in dynamic hiring candidate experiences.
  • Work on the job description and job posting for each assigned open requirement to be able to post on social media and job boards.
  • Execute the full life cycle recruiting process, including sourcing, interviewing, presenting candidates, and negotiating offers.
  • Execute recruitment plan by aggressively recruiting for well-qualified candidates from a variety of sources, managing selection process to include interviewing, assessing candidates, screening, research, cold calling, and filling the staffing needs within the defined service and performance criteria.
  • Maintain the data integrity within the Applicant Tracking System.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and sourcing across multiple types of roles and functions.
  • Experience recruiting for US-based clients within nearshore LATAM delivery models.
  • Previous IT Recruiting experience is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and maximize team performance, while maintaining a working environment that’s fun and professionally rewarding.
  • Experience with use of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Microsoft Office (e.g, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), career portals and AI Tools.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to optimize sourcing, screening, and candidate engagement.
  • Demonstrate responsibility by independently managing tasks, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high-quality work standards in a remote environment.
  • High level of emotional intelligence and candidate experience focus.
  • Ability to balance and manage many simultaneous competing priorities with multiple profiles.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions with limited information.
  • High level of resilience and ability to stay focused and solution-oriented in challenging hiring processes.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must haves

  • TypeScript proficiency (3+ years)
  • Proficiency with Playwright
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest
  • Experience with React Testing Library
  • Understanding of Page Object Model
  • Experience with REST/RPC API testing
  • Experience with Git and GitHub Actions
  • Experience with monorepo architecture (PNPM workspaces, Turborepo)

  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English, daily communication with US-team members


Nice to have

  • Drizzle ORM or similar TypeScript ORM experience
  • Experience with microfrontend architecture
  • Storybook / visual regression testing

  • Work within an agile team alongside developers to ensure testability of new features from design phase

title: Coordenador(a) CSC – RH
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


A posição de Coordenador(a) de CSC RH é fundamental para aprimorar a eficiência e a qualidade dos serviços de Recursos Humanos. Os desafios inerentes à área e ao cargo exigem um profissional com visão estratégica e capacidade de execução.


Desafios da área:

Padronizar processos e promover melhorias contínuas no CSC de RH, conciliando demandas de alto volume com a necessidade de estabilidade operacional e adequação a mudanças legais.

Conduzir iniciativas de inovação, novos processos e a transformação digital da área.


Desafio do cargo:

Coordenar a operação de atendimento de chamados de RH (nível 1), garantindo qualidade, resolutividade, empatia e o estrito cumprimento dos SLAs.

Atuar como referência técnica para áreas de interface (DP, Jurídico, TI) e ponto focal do sistema de atendimento.


Principais atividades:


  • O(A) Coordenador(a) será responsável por uma série de atividades administrativas e de atendimento aos clientes internos, essenciais para o funcionamento eficaz do CSC de RH, garantindo a excelência no atendimento e a otimização dos processos.
  • Coordenar o atendimento de chamados de RH nível 1, assegurando qualidade, padronização e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Realizar a gestão direta das equipes de atendimento, gestão documental, homologações, atendimento presenciais;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de performance (SLAs), propondo ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico do sistema de atendimento escolhido pela companhia (gestão de acessos, incidentes e suporte).
  • Estabelecer contato estratégico com áreas de interface (Departamento Pessoal, Jurídico, Relações Trabalhistas e TI).
  • Coordenar o canal digital de atendimento do RH e apoiar projetos de automação e melhorias sistêmicas.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Para esta posição, procuramos um profissional com um conjunto específico de experiências e habilidades que o capacitem a enfrentar os desafios e a desempenhar as atividades com sucesso.
  • Experiência prévia em CSC de RH ou áreas operacionais de Recursos Humanos.
  • Desejáveis conhecimentos em Rotinas de Departamento Pessoal, legislação trabalhista e gestão documental.
  • Vivência em gestão de equipes, análise de indicadores e atendimento ao cliente interno.
  • Comunicação clara, postura colaborativa, empatia e capacidade de mediação.
  • Organização, foco em detalhes, visão analítica e proatividade.


O que esperamos?


Esperamos um profissional que seja referência técnica e comportamental, que atue com senso de dono e comprometimento com resultados, contribuindo ativamente para a evolução da cultura de excelência do CSC de RH.


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00h as 17:48h

Local: Sem localidade específica, à definir.


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

  • Understanding governance, security, and compliance in enterprise analytics.
  • Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing, ETL, and pipelines/dataflows

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Na Workana, estamos em busca de um/a Engenheiro/a Fullstack Sênior para integrar o time de um dos nossos clientes e assumir um papel estratégico no desenvolvimento de ferramentas internas e sistemas de backoffice.


Sobre o cliente:

Trata-se de uma plataforma que gerencia fluxos logísticos altamente complexos, operando em múltiplas regiões e ambientes de alto volume. Atuando sob um modelo competitivo de ROWE – Results-Only Work Environment, no qual buscamos pessoas que desafiem o pensamento tradicional, proponham novas ideias e ajudem a redefinir como as operações modernas são construídas e escaladas.


Sobre o Projeto:

O/a profissional terá um papel estratégico nas decisões técnicas, na definição de arquiteturas robustas e na entrega de funcionalidades que impulsionam nossas operações em dezenas de cidades. A plataforma evoluiu para lidar com fluxos logísticos altamente complexos, e o time de engenharia encara desafios empolgantes todos os dias. Buscamos alguém que vá além da excelência técnica: que escreva código de alto nível, lidere iniciativas de impacto, mentore colegas e contribua ativamente para moldar o futuro dos nossos sistemas.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Liderar a implementação de módulos frontend robustos e micro-frontends para nossa plataforma interna.
  • Projetar e manter a arquitetura e lógica backend utilizando Node.js, Express e MySQL.
  • Participar de discussões de design de sistemas e tomadas de decisão técnicas.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias em toda a stack com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código seguindo boas práticas, revisões e testes automatizados.
  • Colaborar de perto com os times de Produto, Design e Operações para entender e resolver problemas reais de usuários.
  • Oferecer orientação técnica e mentoria para outros/as engenheiros/as.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.
  • Mínimo 5 anos de experiência profissional como desenvolvedor/a fullstack.
  • Proficiência em Node.js e Express , incluindo design assíncrono e APIs REST .
  • Forte domínio em React.js (Context API, hooks, componentes customizados, gerenciamento de estado).
  • Experiência sólida com MySQL . Elasticsearch é um diferencial.
  • Experiência integrando bibliotecas de mapas (Google Maps, Mapbox) .
  • Confortável trabalhando com Firebase para armazenamento.
  • Conhecimento em AWS (S3, Lambda) .
  • Capacidade de arquitetar sistemas escaláveis , seguros e de fácil manutenção.
  • Fluência em escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado.
  • Boa comunicação, espírito de equipe e atitude proativa.
  • Disponibilidade para participar de rodízio de plantão técnico (on-call rotation) , cobrindo turnos noturnos e períodos de alta demanda.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em horas extras remuneradas, em caso de incidentes técnicos.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento e uso de Typescript.
  • Experiência com logística ou plataformas operacionais complexas.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito).


Condições Contratuais e Benefícios:

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto.
  • Jornada: Tempo integral (8 horas por dia).
  • Remuneração: Entre R$ 11.000,00 e R$ 14.000,00 mensais.
  • Contratação: PJ via cooperativa, diretamente com o cliente.
  • Estabilidade: Possibilidade de parceria de longo prazo.
  • Notebook da empresa.
  • Dia de folga remunerada no aniversário.
  • 5 dias de Paid Time Off por ano, além do período de férias.
  • Ambiente multicultural, com oportunidades de aprendizado junto a equipes de diversos países da região.


Processo de Seleção:

  • Vídeo screening rápido na plataforma Hireflix;
  • Teste técnico prático na plataforma Adaface (simulando desafios reais);
  • Breve call de alinhamento com recruiter da Workana;
  • Entrevista Técnica Cultural + Live Coding com cliente.


Se você está interessado/a nessa posição e acha que é a pessoa certa, aguardamos sua inscrição. Se você for selecionado/a para continuar, alguém da equipe Workana Talent entrará em contato com você!

title: Clinical Research Coordinator
description:
Company Overview

Bioscience Consulting, Inc. is a boutique, compliance‑focused CRO specializing in medical device development across Latin America. Our cross‑cultural team supports early‑stage research with tailored regulatory and clinical services. We deliver high‑quality, ethics‑driven solutions to help innovators bring safe and effective technologies to market.

Position: Clinical Research Coordinator (Junior / Early‑Career)

Location: Florianopolis, Santa Catarina, Brasil — Hybrid (onsite + remote)

Employment: Part‑time , contract

Role Summary: We are hiring a proactive Clinical Research Coordinator to support medical device clinical studies in Florianopolis. Reporting to the Clinical Project Lead, you will coordinate daily trial activities, ensure protocol and GCP compliance, manage participant interactions, and maintain accurate study documentation in both English and Portuguese

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support study startup, site initiation, and routine site activities.
  • Screen, enroll, and consent participants according to protocol and local regulations.
  • Collect and enter clinical data in EDC systems; maintain source documents.
  • Help to prepare and submit safety reports (SAEs/ADRs) and support regulatory filings.
  • Maintain Trial Master File and site regulatory binders; ensure document/version control.
  • Facilitate communication between sponsors, sites, monitors, and vendors.
  • Support monitoring visits, audits, and corrective actions.
  • Track study timelines, enrollment metrics, and deliverables; proactively escalate risks.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, medical, or health‑related field.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and clinical trial processes.
  • Some hands‑on experience in clinical research coordination or related roles.
  • Experience with clinical data capture / EDC or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Experience managing patient interactions and preparing safety reports.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Being proactive is key. Must be able to demonstrate a high degree of autonomy
  • Prior experience with medical device studies is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Clinical Trials and their related procedures
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to collaborate with diverse teams

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on early‑stage medical device projects.
  • Hybrid work model with flexible schedule and supportive, cross‑cultural team.
  • Competitive compensation (please include desired salary in application ).
  • Contractual benefits per Brazilian labor regulations.

How to Apply : Submit your CV and a short cover letter outlining your relevant experience and desired compensation.

description:

Nice to have

  • Contribute to the testing strategy across multiple solution packages in the monorepo
  • Work within an agile team alongside developers to ensure testability of new features from design phase
